statements.text: Katie Hooker will begin her second season as head coach of the Roadrunners women's soccer program in 2026.

Coach Hooker was named the head coach of the MSU Denver women's soccer program on March 31, 2025, bringing with her more than two decades of coaching and playing experience at the collegiate, professional, and club levels.
